en: A) {x : x is an even number}
B) {x : x = n², n ∈ ℕ, 1 ≤ n ≤ 5}
D) {x : x is a prime number}
hi: B) {x : x = n², n ∈ ℕ, 1 ≤ n ≤ 5}

q.en: 8. Which fundamental formula relates cardinal numbers of two sets A and B?
q.hi: 8. दो समुच्चयों A और B के कार्डिनल नंबरों को जोड़ने वाला सूत्र है?

en: A) n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) + n(A ∩ B)
B) n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A ∩ B)
hi: A) n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) + n(A ∩ B)
B) n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A ∩ B)
